Every number I could recompute equals the builder's (about 6,000 compared values; the 30 saved networks bit for bit from tables I built myself; 3 raw archive days decoded with my own code equal the stored box in all 268,710 values; the figure to 0.3 point; a sandbox --rescore regenerates the JSON, the figure and 189 prediction sets identically). The E2a shuffled control measures the harm of misleading slots, not the information of the forecast; E2b's control does the latter and is clean. The E2b 1-day result (+20.3 points, +0.184 average precision, 4 of 4 test years) is a clear gain within a small split (335 onsets, 4 test years, a weaker base) and not comparable in level with E2a.
